items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: she's no Nancy Dixon, I don't think.

ctx.x: I mean the big development of Houston has been since World War II, hasn't it really?

I wasn't here. I tell you what my mother says, Stan, and I want you to hear this, and I want you to look at Houston today, you can, and I think about what she said. She didn't pass until '75. She got to see some of it. But her predictions were very good, and she's no Nancy Dixon, I don't think. (Jeanne Dixon--ed.)
Well, when you lived on Nance Street, was that sort of in the city or was that getting out a bit?
